metadata.title: Secure Endpoint Relying System SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan template for systems that rely on Secure Endpoint to determine whether endpoint devices are acceptable execution environments.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: An application or service that consumes endpoint trust, posture, and lifecycle signals from the Secure Endpoint Platform to make access, execution, or data handling decisions.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP as the authoritative source of endpoint trust.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Endpoint trust signals are combined with identity context provided by Secure Identity.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Network enforcement of endpoint trust and posture is performed by Secure Network.

props.name: endpoint-trust-consumption
props.remarks: The system consumes endpoint trust, posture, and tier signals and must not implement its own endpoint trust logic.

props.name: endpoint-tier-awareness
props.remarks: The system must be capable of consuming endpoint tier classification (e.g., COBO L1, COBO L2) to determine eligibility.

props.name: prohibited-practice
props.remarks: The system must not perform independent endpoint compliance checks, posture evaluation, or trust determination.

props.name: cryptographic-reliance
props.remarks: Endpoint identity assertions relied upon by the system must be cryptographically validated using institutional PKI and Key Management services.

props.name: zero-trust-alignment
props.remarks: Endpoint trust signals are treated as conditional inputs to authorization decisions.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines relying system responsibilities and boundaries only. Endpoint trust establishment, enforcement, posture evaluation, and lifecycle governance are externalized to Secure Endpoint.

components.title: Endpoint Trust Consumer
components.description: Logical representation of an application component that consumes endpoint trust and posture signals.

roles.title: System Owner
roles.remarks: Defines how the application consumes endpoint trust signals and what endpoint tiers are acceptable.

roles.title: Endpoint Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Approves endpoint eligibility requirements and ensures correct reliance on Secure Endpoint.

control-implementation.remarks: All endpoint trust, posture evaluation, cryptographic identity, and lifecycle controls are inherited from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP. This relying system SSPP documents consumption and boundary conditions only.
